experiences.title: IT Intern — Networking & Maintenance
responsibilities: Assisted in maintaining computer systems and network infrastructure for a major financial institution.
Supported LAN configuration, routing, and switching under supervision of senior network engineers.
Installed and updated operating systems and software applications across multiple departments.
Diagnosed hardware and software issues; performed preventive maintenance to improve system reliability.
Collaborated with IT staff to ensure secure and efficient banking operations.
Followed organizational security procedures and best practices for data protection.
